title.en: Minor-arc moments and binary Goldbach exceptions
title.zh: 次弧矩与二元哥德巴赫例外数

description.en: Sum the squared Fourier coefficients of the masked prime square. A lower bound on each major coefficient and an upper bound on the minor-arc sum then bound the number of exceptions in a dyadic interval.
description.zh: 对指示函数截取的素数指数和平方，其傅里叶系数的模平方可求和估计。结合各主弧系数的下界与次弧指数和的上界，可控制倍增区间内的例外数。
